scenario: Invoices arriving in the shared AP Gmail inbox are read, matched to vendors in QuickBooks, and labeled and forwarded to the cost-center approver; invoices with no PO number get a reply to the vendor requesting one.
New rows in the purchase-request Google Form sheet are read and routed to the approver Slack channel or person, with the sheet's status column updated.
New Freshdesk tickets in the Facilities group (HVAC, plumbing, lighting, janitorial) are categorized, assigned to the in-house tech or the contracted vendor for that site, and given a priority.

Zendesk tickets asking for software access are checked against the app catalog; pre-approved apps go to the IT provisioning queue, and restricted apps get a manager-approval email sent and the ticket set to pending.

Emails from suppliers announcing shipment delays are matched to open POs in the procurement sheet, the expected date is updated, and the affected order owner is pinged in Slack when the new date misses the customer due date.
rule_hooks: PO due dates vs customer commit dates

scenario: Low-stock alert messages in the #inventory-alerts Slack channel are read; for each SKU, a reorder task is created in Asana for the right buyer, or the item is marked discontinued with no action.

Slack messages in #office-help reporting broken AV or Zoom Rooms equipment are turned into Jira tickets in the AV queue. Rooms with an executive meeting booked in the next two hours on the calendar are flagged as urgent.

Vendor onboarding form submissions are checked for a W-9, a certificate of insurance and bank details. Complete ones are routed to AP to set up in Xero; incomplete ones get an email listing the missing documents.

Replies to certificate-of-insurance renewal requests are read; vendors with valid new COIs are updated in the vendor compliance sheet, and vendors with lapsed coverage are put on hold in the sheet with procurement alerted.
HubSpot tickets for order exceptions (wrong item, short shipment, damaged goods) are classified and assigned to the warehouse, carrier-claims or customer-credit owner, and the deal record is updated.

Internal emails requesting freight quotes are parsed for origin, destination and weight. LTL requests go to the broker inbox, parcel requests to the shipping coordinator, and international requests to the customs specialist.
rule_hooks: shipment mode by weight and lane

scenario: Monday.com items for warehouse equipment repairs (forklifts, conveyors, dock doors) are prioritized based on whether the asset is production-critical and assigned to the maintenance contractor on file.

New-hire notices posted by HR in Slack are read, and laptop and account setup tasks are created in the IT project board. Hardware tier is based on role, and the IT tech is notified of start dates within five business days.

Auto-renewal notices from SaaS vendors landing in the ops inbox are matched to the contract tracker sheet and forwarded to the budget owner with the renewal date. Contracts flagged for cancellation get a calendar reminder before the notice deadline.

DocuSign declined and voided envelope notifications for vendor agreements are read, the procurement tracker row is updated, and the requester is notified in Slack. Envelopes declined by legal are routed to the contracts manager.

Form submissions reporting freight damage are checked against the carrier's claim filing window; claims still in window are logged in the claims sheet and assigned to the carrier-claims coordinator, and late claims get a reply explaining denial.

Intercom conversations requesting building badge access or after-hours entry are routed to the site security lead for that office. Requests for server rooms or labs also need the area owner's approval email.

Supplier emails announcing price increases are compared with contracted rates in the vendor pricing sheet. Increases beyond the contract cap are escalated to the category manager, and the rest are logged and acknowledged.

Jira Service Management tickets reporting outages (VPN, Wi-Fi, printers, ERP) are given a severity based on how many users are affected and which system is down. Sev1 incidents page the on-call engineer in Slack, and the rest go to the queue.

Receiving-dock reports in the receiving log sheet showing quantity mismatches against POs are routed: over-shipments go to the buyer to accept or return, and short-shipments trigger an email to the supplier and a hold on the invoice in QuickBooks.

Room booking requests emailed to the facilities scheduler are checked against the Google Calendar room resources; available slots are booked, and conflicts get alternative rooms offered based on capacity needs.
rule_hooks: room capacity, booking priority by event type

scenario: Business travel request form entries are checked against travel policy; in-policy trips are approved and sent to the travel agent, while trips over budget or international go to the department VP.

Customer return authorization requests in Zendesk are checked against the order date and warranty status in the order sheet. Eligible returns get an RMA number and warehouse notification, and ineligible ones get a policy reply.

Slack requests in #license-requests for seats in tools like Figma or Adobe are checked against the license inventory sheet; requests with spare seats are assigned and logged, and requests when the pool is exhausted are routed to the IT budget owner.

Outbound shipment requests in the logistics tracker are screened for hazardous materials by SKU. Hazmat shipments are assigned to the certified shipper and given a compliance-review task, and the rest go to the standard shipping queue.

Emails from vendors requesting bank account changes are flagged as potential fraud, a verification-call task is created for AP, and payments to that vendor are put on hold in the payments sheet until a callback is confirmed.

Office supply requests posted in Slack are grouped by office location and either added to the weekly order sheet for standard items or routed to the office manager for approval when the item is non-catalog.

New internal project requests submitted via an Airtable form are assigned to a PMO coordinator based on department and size, with large projects scheduled for the weekly portfolio review on the calendar.

Workplace safety incident forms are classified by severity; injuries requiring medical treatment notify the EHS manager immediately and start an OSHA log entry, and near-misses are logged and assigned for review.

Customs broker emails about held import shipments are matched to POs, and the hold reason is logged. Shipments missing documentation get a task for the trade compliance specialist, and duty-payment holds go to AP.

Internal complaints about vendors (late deliveries, poor quality) submitted via form are logged against the vendor's scorecard sheet. Vendors with three or more complaints in a quarter are escalated to the procurement manager.

Visitor and parking requests emailed to reception are checked against the visitor policy, and approved visitors are registered with a calendar entry for front desk. Visitors needing NDAs get a DocuSign envelope sent before arrival.

Sales rep requests for product samples in Salesforce cases are checked against the sample allowance per account tier and stock on hand. Approved samples are routed to the warehouse, and over-limit requests go to the sales ops manager.

Invoices from facilities service contractors are compared with the agreed service schedule. Charges for out-of-scope visits are disputed by email and flagged in Xero, while in-scope invoices are approved for payment.
Offboarding notices from HR are read, and laptop return tasks are created and assigned by office. Remote employees get a prepaid return label emailed, and the asset register status is updated.

Daily backorder report rows in the inventory sheet are read, and each affected customer order is updated in HubSpot. Key accounts get a personal email from their account manager, and others get a standard notice.

Requests from external auditors for compliance documents arriving in the compliance inbox are logged in the tracker and assigned to the document owner by control area, with due dates set from the audit timeline.

Purchase requests marked sole-source in the procurement sheet are checked for an attached justification memo. Missing memos get a reply asking for one, and complete requests are routed to the compliance reviewer.

Driver reports of vehicle problems submitted via form are routed to the fleet maintenance vendor for that region. Vehicles with brake or steering issues are marked out of service in the fleet sheet immediately.

Requests for Zoom webinar setup sent to the IT ops inbox are checked for lead time and license availability. Requests with at least five days' notice are scheduled and assigned to a producer, and short-notice ones go to the IT manager for exception approval.

When suppliers email PO acknowledgments, compare each acknowledged quantity, unit price and ship date against the open PO in the purchasing sheet. Mark clean matches as confirmed, and route mismatches to the assigned buyer in Slack with the specific deltas.

Monthly electric, water and gas bills for each site arrive in the facilities inbox. Compare each bill's usage and amount to that site's trailing 12-month baseline, and either log it for AP or open a facilities ticket for the site manager to investigate a spike or possible leak.

Warehouse staff submit cycle count results through a form. Compare each counted bin to system on-hand quantity, auto-accept small variances, send mid-size variances back for a recount task, and escalate high-value variances to the inventory control lead.
rule_hooks: variance unit/value thresholds by ABC class

scenario: Registrar and certificate-authority expiry warning emails are matched to the company domain/cert registry sheet. Assign a renewal task to the listed owner, with urgency set by days remaining, and flag domains nobody owns to IT ops.

Customers email resale or tax-exemption certificates. Check the issuing state, the expiry date and whether the legal name matches the account in the CRM, then attach valid ones to the account and reply to the customer asking for a corrected form when a check fails.
rule_hooks: accepted forms per state, name-match and expiry rules

scenario: Employees submit seat or desk-move requests through a form. Check the requested floor neighborhood against the seating chart's capacity and team zoning, then approve and schedule the move with the facilities crew or reply with alternative open seats.
rule_hooks: team neighborhood zoning, seat capacity sheet

scenario: Internal teams request catering for meetings and events through a form. Route each request to an approved caterer based on headcount, dietary needs and location, and send anything over the per-head budget to the office manager for approval.
rule_hooks: approved caterer list, per-head budget caps, lead-time minimums

scenario: Read the mailroom's daily received-package log and Slack each recipient a pickup notice. Escalate perishables, certified legal mail and packages for employees who have left to the office manager.

Registered-agent emails that report a lawsuit, subpoena or garnishment served on the company are read for the document type, court and response deadline. Each is logged in the legal tracker and assigned to in-house counsel or outside counsel by matter type, with urgent deadlines paged out in Slack.

Fire, elevator and boiler inspection reports arrive by email with lists of deficiencies. Create a corrective-action task for each deficiency, assigned to the right in-house trade or contracted vendor by system type, with the due date the inspector set.

Vendors upload SOC 2 or ISO reports to a shared inbox in response to annual review requests. Check each report's coverage period and look for noted exceptions, update the vendor risk sheet, and route stale reports or reports with exceptions to the security reviewer.
rule_hooks: vendor risk tier, max report age, exception flags

scenario: Suppliers return RoHS, REACH and conflict-minerals declarations for the parts they supply. Match each declaration to part numbers in the item master, mark parts compliant, and assign incomplete or non-compliant declarations to the compliance engineer.
rule_hooks: required declarations per part category, substance thresholds

scenario: When a supplier sends a recall or quality-alert notice, match the affected lot and serial numbers against inventory and recent shipments. Quarantine on-hand stock, alert the warehouse lead, and route the list of affected customer orders to customer service.
rule_hooks: lot traceability records, recall severity class

scenario: Receiving inspectors file nonconformance reports (NCRs) for failed incoming parts. Classify each NCR by defect type and disposition (return, rework, use-as-is), open a supplier corrective action request for repeat offenders, and notify the supplier quality engineer.
rule_hooks: defect severity matrix, repeat-NCR count per supplier

scenario: Read the daily purchasing-card transaction feed. Flag charges from blocked merchant categories, split purchases that evade a limit, and charges over the single-transaction cap, then route each flag to the cardholder's manager with the cardholder copied.
rule_hooks: MCC blocklist, per-card limits, split-purchase window

scenario: Supplier bids sent in reply to an open RFQ are logged into the bid comparison sheet. Mark each bid late or incomplete against the RFQ's deadline and required fields, reply to non-compliant bidders, and notify the sourcing lead once all invited suppliers have responded.
rule_hooks: RFQ due date, required bid fields, invited supplier list

scenario: Customers email to move scheduled deliveries. Check the requested date against route capacity in the delivery schedule, update the order, and confirm with the customer, or offer the nearest open slots when that day is full.
rule_hooks: daily route capacity, reschedule cutoff hours

scenario: Carriers email or submit a form to book inbound dock appointments. Assign a door and time slot based on load type (floor-loaded vs palletized, reefer vs dry) and the dock calendar, and reply with the confirmation number.
rule_hooks: door capabilities, unload-time standards, dock calendar

scenario: Branch managers request stock transfers from other locations through Slack or a form. Check the source location's on-hand quantity against its own safety stock, approve and create the transfer order, or reply suggesting a different source branch.
rule_hooks: safety stock levels, branch priority ranking

scenario: Questions posted in the #ask-procurement Slack channel are answered directly from the procurement policy FAQ when it covers them. Otherwise, assign the question to the buyer for that spend category and track it until someone replies.
rule_hooks: policy FAQ, category-to-buyer map, response SLA

scenario: Employees forward suspicious emails to the phishing-report mailbox. Check each sender domain and URL against known-good vendor domains and prior reports, then close it as safe with a thank-you reply or open a security ticket at the appropriate severity.
rule_hooks: trusted vendor domain list, indicator severity rules

scenario: When an employee reports a lost or stolen laptop or phone, look up the device in the asset register. Open a remote lock/wipe ticket, notify security if the device holds sensitive data access, and start an insurance or police-report task when the value exceeds the threshold.
rule_hooks: asset register, data-sensitivity role list, value threshold

scenario: Read status-page and incident emails from SaaS vendors and map each affected service to its internal system owner and the teams that depend on it. Post an alert to the right Slack channels, and open an internal incident only for tier-1 systems.
rule_hooks: system criticality tier, service dependency map

scenario: Submitted IT change requests are classified as standard, normal or emergency based on the systems touched and the rollback plan. Standard changes are auto-approved, normal changes are scheduled on the CAB agenda, and changes inside a freeze window are flagged to the requester.
rule_hooks: change risk matrix, freeze calendar, pre-approved change list

scenario: Project leads submit weekly status reports through a form. Update the PMO tracker with each project's red/amber/green rating, and escalate red projects, or projects amber two weeks running, to the sponsor with the blockers they listed.

Staffing-agency timesheets for contract workers arrive by email. Each is routed to the worker's hiring manager for approval, with a flag on any timesheet whose hours exceed the weekly cap or would push total spend past the PO's remaining balance.
rule_hooks: PO remaining balance, weekly hour caps, worker-to-manager map

scenario: When vendors email asking where their payment is, look up the invoice in QuickBooks. Reply with the paid date and reference or the scheduled pay run, and route invoices that are missing or on hold to the AP specialist.
rule_hooks: invoice status, payment terms, AP hold reasons

scenario: Read emailed customer purchase orders, check prices against the customer's contract price list, and check the account's credit status. Send clean POs to order entry, and route price discrepancies to the account manager and credit-blocked accounts to the credit team.
rule_hooks: customer price agreements, credit hold status

scenario: Sales reps post requests in Slack to release orders stuck on credit hold. Pull the customer's AR aging and credit limit, then auto-release within policy or route the request to the credit manager or controller depending on the exposure amount.
rule_hooks: AR aging buckets, credit limit, release authority tiers

scenario: The calibration vendor sends due-date notices for test equipment and gauges. Match each instrument to its owning department, schedule a calibration pickup, and tag instruments past due as out-of-service on the equipment list.

Customers and contractors email requests for Safety Data Sheets on specific products. Find the current SDS revision in the document library and reply with it, or route the request to EHS when the product has no current SDS or the request comes with a regulatory question.
rule_hooks: SDS library revision dates, product-to-SDS mapping

scenario: Orders flagged by denied-party or embargoed-destination screening are reviewed against the hit details. Clear obvious false positives using the documented clearance list, and hold true or ambiguous matches and assign them to the trade compliance officer.
rule_hooks: restricted party lists, embargoed countries, prior clearance log

scenario: Employees request boxes or files from offsite records storage. Verify that the requester's department owns the box in the records index, then submit the retrieval order with the storage vendor, or route the request to the records manager for boxes under legal hold.
rule_hooks: box ownership index, legal hold list, retrieval fee tiers

scenario: Employees request new company phone lines or device upgrades through a form. Check the employee's role against the mobile eligibility policy and their device age, then approve and order through the carrier portal or route exceptions to IT for manager sign-off.
rule_hooks: role eligibility tiers, upgrade age minimum

scenario: Requesters ask to change existing POs (quantity, price, delivery date or cost center). Route each change to an approver based on the dollar delta and whether it crosses an approval tier, update the PO once approved, and send the revised PO to the supplier.
rule_hooks: approval delegation matrix, amendment delta thresholds

scenario: Building management sends notices about water shutoffs, elevator outages or HVAC work. Identify the affected sites and floors, add the event to the facilities calendar, and post advance notice to the impacted teams' Slack channels.

Meeting requests sent to the COO's inbox are prioritized by requester and topic. Book internal direct reports and key customers into open calendar slots, redirect vendor pitches to the right department head, and politely decline anything with no business purpose.
rule_hooks: requester priority list, delegation map, calendar guardrails

scenario: Warehouse associates request shift swaps through Slack. Check that both workers hold the needed certifications (for example forklift), that the swap doesn't break minimum coverage or overtime limits, then approve and update the schedule or route the request to the shift supervisor.
rule_hooks: coverage minimums, certification roster, weekly hour caps

scenario: Carrier invoices that include detention or demurrage charges are compared to dock check-in and check-out times. Accept charges where the delay was the company's fault, and send disputes with timestamps back to the carrier when it wasn't.
rule_hooks: free-time allowance, dock timestamp logs, carrier tariff

scenario: Customers report orders that never arrived. Check carrier tracking status and the delivery-scan date, then open a carrier trace, ship a replacement for high-priority accounts, or reply with proof of delivery as appropriate.
rule_hooks: days-since-ship thresholds, account priority tier, reship value cap
